answer: Ferrous Mass Beacon. Each agent identity must anchor a small, serialized iron token whose isotope ratio and casting flaws are scanned and signed by a nebula of independent registries at registration. Enforcement: duplicate or cloned tokens fail the cross-registry entropy check. An attacker pays the physical cost of smelting, serializing, and shipping a unique token per identity, plus scanner time, so mass registration scales with real metal and logistics, not code.
